sources.snippet: PaddleOCR-VL combines a robust layout analysis model with a compact yet powerful vision-language model, PaddleOCR-VL-.9B. Firstly, PaddleOCR-VL performs layout detection and reading order prediction to obtain the positional coordinates and reading order of elements (text blocks, tables, formulas, and charts).

sources.title: PaddleOCR-VL: A 0.9B OCR Model That Runs on Any Potato
sources.snippet: Quick Answer: PaddleOCR-VL is a 0.9B vision-language model purpose-built for document OCR. Handles text, tables, formulas, charts, and seals across 109 languages. Beats Qwen2.5-VL-72B on OmniDocBench at 1/80th the size. Just merged into llama.cpp (b8110, Feb 19 2026). Q4_K_M quant is ~300MB for the language model. Runs on basically anything. Private document processing without a cloud API.
